title: sdks: unify auth/retries & streaming ergonomics across py/ts/go + parity bumps to v1.65.0
author: Maya Chen
release_notes:
- Unify auth token refresh and retry semantics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs.
- Improve streaming API ergonomics (cancellable streams, consistent event shape).
- Parity fixes for streaming backpressure and idle reconnect behavior.
- Bumped SDK versions to v1.65.0 across languages.
description:
Motivation: Multiple SDKs diverged in auth retry behavior and streaming ergonomics which caused inconsistent app-level retry behavior and mismatched streaming event shapes across platforms. This PR consolidates the shared design and applies parity fixes so integrations behave the same across Python, TypeScript, and Go.

Summary of changes:
- Implement centralized auth token refresher with backoff and jitter; SDKs now expose the same configuration knobs (max_retries, retry_backoff_base_ms, retry_backoff_max_ms).
- Standardize transient vs permanent error classification used by retries and surface a common RetryPolicy object in each SDK.
- Streaming ergonomics: introduce a unified StreamClient interface (cancel(), on_event(), on_error()) and ensure event payloads use a consistent envelope {type, id, data, meta}.
- Parity bug fixes: fix TS/Go backpressure handling that caused data loss under aggressive batching; ensure Python stream reconnect preserves cursor and KV cache metadata.
- Update examples, docs, and changelogs for all three SDKs.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc: ENG-2145 (linked)
- [x] Unit + integration tests added across SDKs
- [x] CI green after rerun
- [x] Docs updated and examples validated
- [x] Version bumps applied and changelogs updated

Testing notes:
- Local and CI integration runs for python/ts/go streaming harnesses with simulated network flakiness (latency/jitter/drop).
- Added deterministic tests for RetryPolicy corner cases (429, 503, connect timeouts) and backoff timing bounds.
- Verified manual e2e against redwood local staging: auth refresh with rotated key, long-lived streaming session reconnect, and cross-language parity checks.

Rollout plan:
- Release SDK packages to internal staging registries (pypi/testpypi, npm tag rc, go proxy) then promote to public.
- Monitor SDK error rates and streaming disconnects via per-sdk dashboards and the existing canary test suite.

Notes:
- SUP-4532 surfaced a customer reproducible where TS SDK retried on 401s without refreshing token; unified behavior now refreshes then retries once.
- No breaking changes to public APIs; added optional ergonomic helpers on streaming clients (backwards compatible).
- Version bump to v1.65.0 for all three SDKs to keep cross-language parity.
